title: Clean invoice, exact PO match
story: Text PDF, explicit PO reference, 4 itemised lines, separate 8% tax. Everything ties out.

title: Small freight charge within tolerance
story: Invoice is $12 over the PO because of an unplanned freight line. Within the 1% / $100 tolerance, so it auto-approves with a note.

title: Unit price above PO price
story: Vendor billed $4.65/unit against a PO price of $4.20 - a $675 (10.7%) variance. Outside tolerance, so it is held with a line-level breakdown.

title: Resubmitted invoice (already paid)
story: Sent again as a 'payment reminder' with the number written BL7781 and a European date. Already paid as BL-7781 - normalised fingerprint catches it.

title: Milestone 2 of 3 on a split PO
story: Second milestone against a $30,000 PO that already has $12,000 billed. Fits the remaining balance, so it approves and the PO drops to $6,000 remaining.

title: Final milestone exceeds PO balance
story: Phase 3 plus an out-of-scope 'data migration' line. Cumulative billing would exceed the $30,000 PO by $3,000 - held for a PO change order. (Run after sample 05.)

title: No PO reference - inferred from lines
story: No PO number anywhere on the invoice. The vendor has two open POs; line items and amount match PO-4505 uniquely, so the PO is inferred with high confidence.

title: Vendor not in vendor master
story: Looks legitimate, but Tidewater Logistics has never been onboarded and PO-4509 does not exist. Routed to procurement for vendor onboarding before any payment.

title: Vendor is blocked in master data
story: Quillon Print Co. is on the vendor master but blocked (failed bank verification). No PO. Rejected outright.

title: No invoice number or date
story: Pro-forma style document: PO matches perfectly but there is no invoice number and no date, so it cannot be booked. Held with a request to the vendor.

title: Scanned paper invoice (image-only PDF)
story: No text layer at all - a photocopied page. Text is recovered with OCR (Gemini vision online, Tesseract offline) and then flows through the same rules.

title: Phone photo of an invoice (PNG)
story: A slightly skewed phone photo emailed in as a PNG. Same OCR path; PO-4508 matches exactly.

title: Indian GST invoice (INR, CGST/SGST)
story: Different country, different layout: HSN column, CGST + SGST instead of one tax line, lakh digit grouping, DD/MM date, a 'Total' row with a quantity before the amount, and a grand total with no paise.
